bus.via: Chía to Terminal de Transporte Zipaquirá

trips.route_note: Take a direct bus from Bogotá's Portal del Norte terminal to Zipaquirá (about 1 hour), then a short taxi or local bus to the Salt Cathedral.
see: Salt mine tunnels and the Way of the Cross
Zipaquirá historic centre and Plaza de Bolívar
trips.tour_query: Zipaquirá Salt Cathedral day trip from Bogotá
trips.why: The direct bus takes about 1h 17m from Portal del Norte, faster and cheaper than a car or taxi for this distance, with a short taxi or local bus for the last stretch to the Salt Cathedral.
know: The Salt Cathedral is underground inside a salt mine, so bring a warm layer.
Allow time for the short last-mile trip from the bus terminal to the cathedral.
Weekends are busier, so go early in the day.
